Setup

```{r}
library(here)
library(ragg)
library(variancePartition)
library(arrow)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggtext)
require(ggrepel)
library(broom)
library(table1)
library(patchwork)

source(here("functions.R"))
theme_set(figTheme())
plots <- list()
```
Data import
```{r}
meta_pre_qc <- readRDS(here("00_setup/data/metadata.samples.preQC.rds"))
analytes <- readRDS(here("00_setup/data/metadata.analytes.rds"))
counts_pre_qc <- read_parquet(here("00_setup/data/count_tidy.preQC.parquet"))
```

# Participants characteristics

Prior to proteomic QC as some samples included in ELISA measurements

Table 1
```{r}
table1(
  x = ~ sex + age_at_dx + gc_days + baseline_crp + baseline_esr + platelets + freezer_months + cranial_isch_comp_rm + pmryesno | ref_dx,
  data = meta_pre_qc %>%
    mutate(
      ref_dx = fct_recode(ref_dx, `non-GCA`="not_cGCA", GCA="cGCA"),
      age_at_dx = setLabel(age_at_dx, "Age"),
      sex = factor(sex, levels = c("female", "male"), labels = c("Female", "Male")),
      sex = setLabel(sex, "Sex"),
      freezer_months = setLabel(freezer_months, "Sample storage time (months)"),
      gc_days = setLabel(gc_days, "Glucocorticoid treatment (days)"),
      baseline_crp = setLabel(baseline_crp, "CRP (mg/L)"),
      baseline_esr = setLabel(baseline_esr, "ESR (mm/h)"),
      platelets = setLabel(platelets, "Platelet count (109/L)"),
      cranial_isch_comp_rm = setLabel(cranial_isch_comp_rm, "Cranial ischaemia complications"),
      pmryesno=str_to_title(pmryesno),
      pmryesno=setLabel(pmryesno, "Polymyalgia rheumatica symptoms")
    ),
  overall = FALSE
)
```


# Sample QC

## SomaLogic QC
One sample was flagged as the hybridisation scale factor (7.76)
was outside of 0.4-2.5 range due to a leak - therefore removed
prior to analysis.

```{r}
meta_pre_qc %>% filter(row_check == "FLAG") |> pull(ref_dx)
```
One sample, was flagged as the median normalisation scale factor
for the 20x dilution group (0.39118298) was outside the range of 0.4-2.5. Given
the scale factor is just under the threshold I'll keep an eye on it during the
qc.

## Sample outlier detection.
Outlier samples were detected using two complementary methods.
```{r}
outliers <- list()
outliers$pca <- readRDS(here("00_setup/data/qc/outlier.pca.rds"))
outliers$median_iqr <- readRDS(here("00_setup/data/qc/outlier.median_iqr.rds"))
```
The PCA method highlights samples +/- 5 standard deviations from the mean PC1
and PC2 values.
The Median+IQR method identifies samples +/- 5 standard deviations from the mean
abundance medians and IQRs.
Then I identify samples flagged by either of these methods to exclude.

```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=7}
plots$sample_outliers <- outliers$pca$plot + outliers$median_iqr$plot + theme(legend.position = "none") &
  #plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())
plots$sample_outliers
```
How many samples are flagged by either method?
```{r}
union(outliers$pca$outliers, outliers$median_iqr$outliers) |> length()
```
This samples was removed from the post QC metadata and counts.
```{r}
meta <- readRDS(here("00_setup/data/metadata.samples.postQC.rds"))
counts <- read_parquet(here("00_setup/data/count_tidy.postQC.parquet"))
```

# Aptamer QC
### Descriptive statistics
How many usable SOMAmers on the array?

```{r}
length(unique(analytes$apt_id))
length(unique(analytes$Target))
length(unique(analytes$UniProt))
length(unique(analytes$EntrezGeneSymbol))
```

Targets with multiple aptamers
```{r}
analytes %>%
  select(SeqId, Target) %>%
  mutate(freq = n(), .by = Target) %>%
  select(Target, freq) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  arrange(desc(freq))
```
Number of flagged aptamers
```{r}
table(analytes$ColCheck)
```

:::{.callout-note}
SOMAmers In Tails refers to the cumulative number of SOMAmer reagents in the QC
control with a ratio on any plate outside the accepted accuracy range, 0.8 - 1.2,
when compared to the reference. Flagged SOMAmer reagents are typically retained
for analyses since accuracy across all assay runs is a robust quality metric but
is not a requirement for identification of meaningful biological signal.
:::


### Estimated limit of detection (eLOD)
eLOD calculated using `SomaDataIO::calc_eLOD`.
First calculate the adjusted median absolute deviation (MAD) (1.4826 x MAD),
Then for each SOMAmer, eLOD = median + 3.3 x adjusted MAD
```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=4.5}
elod <- read_parquet(here("00_setup/data/qc/elod.parqet"))
plots$elod <- elod %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = prop)) +
  geom_histogram(colour = "black", fill = "grey75") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.21))) +
  labs(y = "Number of samples", x = "SOMAmers above estimated limit of detection")
plots$elod
min(elod$prop)
```

# Sample and SOMAmer outlier plots
```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=6}
plots$sample_outliers / plots$elod + plot_layout(heights = c(2, 1)) + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a") & theme(plot.margin = unit(c(5, 6, 5, 5), "pt"), legend.position = "bottom")
```

# PCA
Import SOMAmer log2 RFU PCs
```{r}
prcomp_obj <- readRDS(here("00_setup/data/qc/prcompObject_postQC.rds"))
```

Screeplot
```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=8}
pc_prop_explain <- summary(prcomp_obj)[["importance"]][2, ] %>%
  data.frame(prop_explained = .) %>%
  rownames_to_column("pc")
screeplot <- pc_prop_explain %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = fct_reorder(pc, prop_explained, .desc = TRUE), y = prop_explained * 100)) +
  geom_col(fill = "grey80", colour = "black") +
  labs(x = "PCs", y = "Variance explained (%)") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())

# just first 10 PCs
inset <- pc_prop_explain %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = fct_reorder(pc, prop_explained, .desc = TRUE), y = prop_explained * 100)) +
  geom_col(fill = "grey80", colour = "black") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1)))

screeplot + inset_element(inset, 0.3, 0.3, 1, 1)
```
PC1 can explain `r round(pc_prop_explain[1, 2], 2)*100`% of aptamer abundance variation.

Visualise PCA

```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=5}
(plots$pca_biplot_refdx <- plotPCABiplot(prcompObject = prcomp_obj,
              metadata = mutate(meta, ref_dx = case_match(ref_dx, "not_cGCA" ~ "non-GCA", "cGCA"~"GCA", .default = ref_dx)),
              color_var = "ref_dx",
              x_pc = "PC1", y_pc = "PC2",
              sample_id_col = "study_id",
              marginalDensity = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = col.dx) +
  labs(fill = "Diagnosis"))
```
PC2 is associated with reference diagnosis
```{r}
# pull out PC1 and PC2 scores, add on ref dx and then make tidy
plots$pc_boxplot_refdx <- as.data.frame(prcomp_obj$x) %>%
  rownames_to_column("study_id") %>%
  left_join(meta, by = "study_id") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(PC1, PC2), names_to = "PC1_PC2", values_to = "score")
# plot
plots$pc_boxplot_refdx <- plots$pc_boxplot_refdx %>%
  mutate(ref_dx = case_match(ref_dx, "not_cGCA" ~ "non-GCA", "cGCA"~"GCA", .default = ref_dx)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = ref_dx, y = score)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = ref_dx), width = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~PC1_PC2, scale = "free") +
  # run linear regression and beta and p values to plot
  geom_richtext(
    data = plots$pc_boxplot_refdx %>%
      group_by(PC1_PC2) %>%
      do(tidy(lm(reformulate(termlabels = "ref_dx", response = "score"), data = .))) %>%
      filter(term == "ref_dxcGCA") %>%
      mutate(pval_lab = map_chr(p.value, formatPvalLabel)),
    aes(x = 1.5, y = Inf, vjust = 1, label = paste0("β = ", round(estimate, 2), "<br>", pval_lab)),
    size = 3, fill = NA, label.color = NA
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = col.dx) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "PC score") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

plots$pc_boxplot_refdx
```

# Covariates

### PCA
Here, I am using univariate linear regression to test the association between abundance PCs and potential sources of variation (biological and technical).

Import PCA covariate analysis
```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=6}
pca_assoc <- readRDS(here("00_setup/data/qc/pca_covariate_associations.rds"))
(plots$pca_assoc <- plotlmPCA(lmPCA_output =  mutate(pca_assoc,metric = str_replace(metric, "RFU", "RFU ANML"))))
```
Only values with FDR <0.05 are shown.

Cumulative explainable variance % for first 10 PCs
```{r}
summary(prcomp_obj)[["importance"]][3,][10]*100
```


Site cannot be used as not all C-GCA and Not C-CGA participants originated from all sites
```{r}
meta %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .by = c(ref_dx, site)) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = site, names_from = ref_dx, values_from = n)
```


# Variance partition
```{r}
var_part <- readRDS(here("00_setup/data/qc/variancePartition.rds"))
```
Plot
```{r fig.height=4,fig.width=5}
plots$variancePartition <- as.data.frame(var_part) %>%
  rownames_to_column("apt_id") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols=!apt_id, names_to = "variable", values_to = "prop") %>%
  mutate(variable = case_match(variable,
                               "gc_days" ~ "Glucocorticoid treatment duration",
                               "age_at_dx" ~ "Age",
                               "sex" ~ "Sex",
                               "ref_dx" ~ "Diagnosis",
                               .default = variable)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = prop*100, y = fct_reorder(variable, prop, median))) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = c("age_at_dx" ="Age",
                               "sex" = "Sex",
                               "ref_dx" = "Diagnosis",
                               "iqr_log2_RFU" = "IQR log2 RFU ANML",
                              "gc_days" = "Glucocorticoid treatment duration")) +
  labs(x = "Variance explained (%)", y = NULL)

plots$variancePartition
```
